# WITEC Global

> Wasi Infratech Engineering & Construction provides BIM and engineering services globally and construction services in Nagpur and Kolkata.

WITEC operates two distinct divisions. BIM & Engineering delivers architectural, structural and MEP coordination, clash detection, scan-to-BIM, 4D/5D BIM and digital twins. WITEC Construction delivers civil, RCC, structural, MEP and turnkey construction.
